title: Frozen Yogurt shared dream location
content: Hey y’all, just wanted to share a bizarre dream I had last night. A little of the info will be kinda vague/rambling because I’ve been awake for a bit and forgot, but I’ll try to get down what I can. The weird part of this dream isn’t necessarily the contents (I dream really weird things all the time), but the overpowering sensation that other people have had this one. So, I was in this frozen yogurt shop somewhere in the rural US (I’m from the suburbs myself). I knew fairly quickly that it was a dream, but somehow the store seemed more important than that. The dream started off benign enough, with me waiting in line and chatting with the other customers, who all seemed to think I was someone else. As I was about to get my yogurt, something nonhuman started chasing me, so I ran through the bathroom (which looked more like a bathroom themed backrooms level) into the same frozen yogurt shop, except it was not a frozen yogurt shop anymore, but instead some sort of cultist base. From here I don’t remember a ton, but I do remember that I saw the shop in several other forms, most of which were fairly disturbing. Has anyone ever heard of anything like this? Like I said above, the part of the dream that really freaked me out was a strong memory that someone else had told me about the dream before I had it, as well as other people in the dream frequently alluding to the idea that I was not the only one who had been there, and that someone else had given me that dream. The sensation was so strong that I immediately googled details of the dream after I woke up, thinking that someone else would’ve written something on it. Again, sorry for the rambling :)
